summary.text: Emmanuel Digman is the Republican candidate for Maryland State Senate District 46 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent William Ferguson IV (D) is also running.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 23, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Digman was the Republican nominee against Ferguson for the same District 46 seat in the November 8, 2022 general election.
In 2024 he advanced from the Republican primary for Baltimore City Council President and lost the general election to incumbent Zeke Cohen.
